Q1: Which immutable source should the workflow execute `sync_claude_live_copies.py` from (instead of the pushed `main` commit)?
Choices:
A. The commit behind the verified `stable` release tag, checked out into a separate support directory with its SHA checked, the same way other workflows use `.codex-workflow-src`. Script changes take effect only after a release. (RECOMMENDED)
B. The push's `github.event.before` commit (the `main` tip before this push), so a script change takes effect on the next template push.
C. Both A and B must match byte for byte, otherwise fail closed and send a Telegram alert.
Q2: Which credential should the sync use for pushing branches and opening PRs?
Choices:
A. Keep `GH_PAT` but stop giving it to the checkout (`persist-credentials: false`, default token). Pass it only to the trusted support-copy script after its provenance checks pass, so the PAT only reaches pinned code. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a dedicated GitHub App and mint a token per run, limited to contents and pull requests on this repo and created only after validation. This needs new App secrets (e.g. an App ID and private key) set up by an operator; the workflow fails closed while they are missing.
   **Note:** with B, the App must be allowed to trigger CI and review on the PRs it opens. If not, auto-merge-eligible sync PRs will stall.
C. Use the job's `github.token` with `contents: write` and `pull-requests: write` only, and accept that sync PRs no longer trigger CI or review automatically.
Q3: Should the repo also block AI pipeline changes to the sync implementation, based on path and author?
Choices:
A. Yes: put `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py` and `.github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml` on the protected/write-guard path list, so implement, review and the resolver cannot commit to them, and add a contract test that pins this. (RECOMMENDED)
B. No: the immutable source from Q1 is enough; add no new path guard.
C. Do both A and add a CODEOWNERS entry that requires human review for those two paths.
Assumptions: fix PRs target the integration branch `claude/fix-main-ci-green` named in the issue. Template-to-live parity behaviour, the held-PR path and the `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC` log prefixes stay unchanged.
Missing context: I did not find the write-guard policy file at the path `agents.md` gives (`.github/ai/write_guards.v1.json`), so planning has to locate the live guard list for Q3:A.
